Title: [LSJ] Soul Burn vs Dragon's Breath Rounds + Rotschreck

Messages.Author: Charles Lechasseur
Messages.Body:
here is a question that was asked during our Montréal NAC Qualifier. we
couldn't find an official answer.

Vampire A (acting) is in combat with Vampire B (reacting). B maneuvers
with a Saturday Night Special. A strikes with Soul Burn at superior. B
strikes with the gun.

Can B then play Dragon's Breath Rounds and Rotschreck? the question was
asked because of Soul Burn's "the weapon does no damage" text.

relevant card text follows.

Name: Saturday-Night Special
Cardtype: Equipment
Cost: 1 pool
Weapon, gun.
1R damage each strike, with an optional maneuver each combat.

Name: Soul Burn
Cardtype: Combat
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Thaumaturgy
[tha] Strike: 1R damage. This damage cannot be prevented by cards that
require Fortitude [for]. If the opposing vampire attempts to strike with a
weapon this round, he or she does no damage.
[THA] As above, but for 2R damage.

Name: Dragon's Breath Rounds
Cardtype: Combat
Ammo.
Only usable before resolution of a gun's strike. That gun inflicts +2
aggravated damage each strike for the remainder of this combat. Burn the
gun after strike resolution. No more than 1 ammo card can be used on a gun
each combat.

Name: Rotschreck
Cardtype: Master
Master: out-of-turn. {Frenzy.}
Put this card on a vampire when an opposing minion attempts to inflict
aggravated damage on him or her, whether the damage would be successfully
inflicted or not. Combat ends. This vampire is tapped and sent to torpor.
This vampire does not untap as normal. During this vampire's next untap
phase, burn this card.

charles lechasseur - da...@novideospamtron.ca

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Charles Lechasseur wrote:
> here is a question that was asked during our Montréal NAC Qualifier. we
> couldn't find an official answer.
>
> Vampire A (acting) is in combat with Vampire B (reacting). B maneuvers
> with a Saturday Night Special. A strikes with Soul Burn at superior. B
> strikes with the gun.

A announces his strike as "Soul Burn superior".
B announced his strike as "Saturday Night Special".
They don't actually strike until strike resolution.

> Can B then play Dragon's Breath Rounds and Rotschreck? the question was
> asked because of Soul Burn's "the weapon does no damage" text.

Yes.
Rotschreck resolves when played, which is before strike resolution.
